0.original: Ysaudore peers over the cliff with concern.

1.original: The area around Camp Riversmeet was once a field of rich, rolling meadows. Now it is a frozen wasteland, home to fierce, hungry wolves. Ysaudore seems intent on driving these beasts away and has entrusted you with a mission: slay three silver wolves.

2.original: You have slain the wolves as requested. Return to Ysaudore, and let her hear of your success.

3.original: Ysaudore thanks you for your hard work. Camp Riversmeet once served as a military outpost, quartering Ishgardian troops and facilitating patrols of the surrounding area. Ysaudore hopes to see the camp reclaimed and the area made safe once more.

48.original: Some ways beyond here lies Camp Riversmeet. The camp was once the center of luscious pastures─a prime grazing field for cattle and other livestock... Now it's home to naught more than wolves.

49.original: Pray help drive the beasts away with sword and spell. Slay three silver wolves─let them learn to fear us.

50.original: Pray drive away the creatures at Camp Riversmeet. Slay three of the silver wolves found skulking there.

51.original: You've already slain those horrid wolves? You have my deepest thanks.

52.original: There was a time when there were Ishgardian troops stationed at Camp Riversmeet. Should we recover the camp─were we able to station soldiers there again─it would make our patrols safer, let them cover more area...

53.original: Before long, we shall move to reclaim the camp. When that time comes, I may call upon your services again.
